attributes.action: Social media restrictions age 16-17 to not take place
attributes.additional_details: This is about the new laws that have been put into place of under 16 social media ban and 16-17 year old's social media curfew. By the age of turning 16 years, you can work, pay tax, you have finished you GCSE's and secondary school, by the age of 17, you can drive/learn, join the army and are becoming an adult, you can also live independently at this age and even have children (don't support teen pregnancy, support pregnant teens. So please parliament take this into consideration!
attributes.background: To not time limit 16-17 year olds as that is the legal age you can work and pay tax to our country, you can join the army and even learn how to drive, yet they are not allowed to scroll on social media after 10pm! Don't take action on this!

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Do not introduce social media curfew for 16 & 17 year olds" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772675
